arguments.body:
Hi,

Summary of the Northwind account review meeting (2026-01-02):

Decisions:
- Phase‑two rollout will start on 2026‑02‑10.
- Weekly status calls will be on Tuesdays at 10:00.
- The reporting dashboard will use the revised metric definitions.

Action items:
- Dana: circulate the revised rollout timeline by 2026‑01‑09.
- Priya: confirm dashboard metric definitions with the data team.
- All: prepare the phase‑two risk register before the next status call.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
